pages.text: Advanced and Extended Life Extractors cannot be destroyed by explosions, but can still be mined normally by players.$(br2)The Life Extractor kills mobs within its configured range and produces Life Fluid based on their current remaining health. Unlike the Bio Crusher, the Life Extractor does not produce drops — it converts the mob's life force directly into fluid.$(br2)$(bold)Variants$()$(br2)| Machine | Upgrade Slots | Energy Capacity | Fluid Capacity | |---------|---------------|-----------------|----------------| | Advanced Life Extractor | 4 | 100,000 FE | 16,000 mB | | Extended Life Extractor | 8 | 200,000 FE | 16,000 mB |$(br2)$(bold)Features$()$(br2)$(bold)Life Fluid Generation$()

$(li)Kills mobs within the configured range$(li)Produces Life Fluid from current remaining health: 0.5 mB per HP by default after the global output multiplier$(li)The server config $(thing)jdte.lifeExtractor.fluidPerHealth$() controls the base amount (0.1 mB by default), and the machine applies a fixed 5x output multiplier$(li)The first 100 health uses the full rate. Each subsequent 100-health band uses 10% less marginal yield than the previous band by default$(li)$(thing)jdte.lifeExtractor.highHealthLossPercent$() controls this marginal loss. Piecewise calculation prevents total output from dropping at a band boundary$(li)Targets are removed directly without normal death drops, experience, or loot events$(li)Fractional output from entity health and upgrade multipliers accumulates in the machine until it reaches 1 mB

$(bold)Low-Lag Batch Processing$()$(br2)| Machine / Mode | Scan Interval | Maximum Batch | Theoretical Throughput | |----------------|---------------|---------------|------------------------| | Advanced Normal | 20 ticks | 4 | 4 entities/s | | Extended Normal | 20 ticks | 8 | 8 entities/s | | Advanced Overclock/Creative | 5 ticks | 8 | 32 entities/s | | Extended Overclock/Creative | 5 ticks | 16 | 64 entities/s |$(br2)Each range query processes several targets at once. Overclock scanning is limited to four queries per second instead of scanning a large area every tick. Underclock uses the normal batch size with a 40-tick interval.

$(li)Fluid is stored in the internal tank and can be extracted with a bucket$(br2)$(bold)Modes$()$(br2)The Life Extractor supports 3 modes:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Hostile$(): Only attacks hostile mobs (default)$(li)$(bold)Passive$(): Only attacks passive mobs$(li)$(bold)All$(): Attacks all mobs$(br2)When a Filter Upgrade is installed, the mode setting is ignored and the filter slots are used to select target entities instead.$(br2)$(bold)Range$()$(br2)$(li)Base radius: 5 blocks (X/Y/Z each)$(li)Adjustable via the GUI$(li)Range Upgrade increases the configurable maximum$(li)Energy cost scales with the configured range$(br2)$(bold)Upgrade Effects$()

| Upgrade | Effect | |---------|--------| | Overclock | Processes a mob batch every 5 ticks, with 10% fluid loss | | Underclock | Fluid yield increased to 1.5x | | Creative | Uses the overclock batch rate, with no fluid loss or energy cost | | Range | Increases configurable range maximum | | Filter | Enables filter slots to select target entities by type | | Capacity | Increases FE and fluid capacity |$(br2)$(bold)Energy$()$(br2)$(li)Base energy cost: 300 FE x range scale factor$(li)Advanced Life Extractor: 100,000 FE capacity$(li)Extended Life Extractor: 200,000 FE capacity$(br2)$(bold)Crafting$()$(br2)$(bold)Advanced Life Extractor$()
An extended version of the Advanced Life Extractor with 8 upgrade slots. Obtained by right-clicking an Advanced Life Extractor with an Extended Upgrade.
